_readme: Maps the save file's opaque compound ids to compound names from items/abilities.md. Evidence + the procedure to extend this map: save_schema.md 'Compound id mapping'. Only ids listed here are used to compute current_stats; unmapped ids make current_stats null (by design -- never guess).

compound_01.name: AMPEA
compound_01.evidence: 12-dossier screenshot solve 2026-08-21 (Reza, Elke, Adel, Lamster, Moon Dog, Antler with compounds + 6 base-only agents): computed base + AMPEA(+partners) matches every dossier exactly under the corrected Sens/Resp column order. The earlier Carla 'compound_01 present but stats unchanged' contradiction is RESOLVED -- her Munich dossier reads exactly base + AMPEA (64/58/66/60); the unchanged-stats read was wrong

compound_02.name: BMA
compound_02.evidence: same solve: AMPEA+BMA reproduces Adel's dossier 79/82/82/84 exactly (pre-EPO), and is the unique table pair summing to the hire-pool delta

compound_08.name: EPO
compound_08.evidence: appeared on Carla after her live EPO application (2026-08-20); Reza's dossier 92/67/75/75 = base + AMPEA + EPO exactly (2026-08-21 solve)

compound_11.name: Bolasterone
compound_11.evidence: application-diff, 2026-08-22: appeared as a new id on all 4 agents cross-checked (Moon Dog/Nancy Lewis, Deadpan/Reza Golshani, Antler/Yves Richoux, Buran/Adel Youssef) the same day Bolasterone was logged as applied to 5 agents (Lamster the 5th, not yet re-pulled). No other compound was reported applied to this set on this date.

compound_03.name: DXAMPEA
compound_03.evidence: application-diff, 2026-08-22: appeared as a new id on Mateo Torres (Grimoire)'s compounds_raw immediately after his in-game DXAMPEA treatment screenshot (3rd compound, after AMPEA+Bolasterone); no other new compound reported for him at that point.

compound_14.name: Danazol
compound_14.evidence: application-diff, 2026-08-22: appeared as a new id on Mateo Torres (Grimoire)'s compounds_raw immediately after his in-game Danazol treatment screenshot (4th compound, after AMPEA+Bolasterone+DXAMPEA, matching Danazol's DXAMPEA prerequisite); no other new compound reported for him at that point.

compound_17.name: Gonadorelin
compound_17.evidence: exact 4-column residual solve, 2026-09-16, from Archer/Eita Tanaka's dossier screenshot (uniqueid generated_agent_98). Base 57/51/50/60 + AMPEA+BMA+DXAMPEA+Bolasterone+EPO = 100/91/86/92; dossier reads 102/92/82/108, leaving a residual of (+2,+1,-4,+16) which matches Gonadorelin's table row exactly on all four stats. No other compound is within 9 total points. This also validates the whole 5-compound chain arithmetic on him.
